newsitem.title: USA: Vitro, Libbey enter glassware deal.
newsitem.headline: Vitro, Libbey enter glassware deal.

text.p: Mexico's Vitro SA said on Monday that it has entered a joint venture agreement with Libbey Inc for Vitro's glassware division and Libbey will acquire Vitro's WorldCrisa unit.
The deal, which is expected to close during the third quarter, is valued approximately $100 million, Vitro said in a statement.
Libbey will become a 49 percent equity holder in Vitrocrisa, a glass tableware maker owned by Vitro.

Also, the two companies will establish reciprocal distribution agreements, making Vitrocrisa a distributor of Libbey products in Mexico, Central and South America. Libbey will distribute Vitrocrisa glass tableware in the United States and Canada, Vitro said.
Vitro called the move "an important step toward our stated goal of reducing Vitro's debt by $300 million in 1997."
Libbey is paying $100 million in cash for its investments in the 49 percent stake in VitroCrisa and the purchase of WorldCrisa, a U.S. spokesman for Vitro said.
Libbey produces tabletop products for the food service industry and is a supplier of glass tableware.
